spans.text: This is Shadowless. I will be taking you through the latest news today.
Galatea Corporation issues a public apology for canceling the Idunn launch event and press conference that were scheduled to take place today.
Galatea pledges to resolve the issue as quickly as possible so that the serum can reach ELID patients at first possible moment.
According to insider information, the launch was canceled because the vehicle transporting the first batch of serums has gone missing.
At 0723 this morning, Berlin Hospital experienced an alleged terrorist attack for the first time since the construction of the quarantine wall.
Three members of the medical staff and four patients were in the wards when the explosion occurred.
The police is currently investigating the source of the explosion. This is frontline correspondent Shadowless bringing you the news...
That concludes today's news. This is Aktuelle Kamera, brought to you by the DRF.
